#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Bind the ordinary full flake retry to every tracked/non-ignored source file.
set -uo pipefail
readonly out="$HOME/.cargo-target/mantle-cairn-resume-20261026/nix-full-after-supervisor-recovery"
if [[ -e "$out" ]]; then exit 1; fi
mkdir -p "$out"
export TMPDIR=/home/brittonr/.cargo-target/t
export XDG_CACHE_HOME=/home/brittonr/.cargo-target/xdg-cache
export NIX_CONFIG=$'builders =\nbuild-dir = /datapool/mantle-store/nix-build-dir-20261025'
snapshot() {
  git rev-parse HEAD > "$out/$1.head"
  git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -z | xargs -0 b3sum 2> "$out/$1.unreadable" | LC_ALL=C sort -k2 > "$out/$1.blake3"
}
snapshot start
date --iso-8601=seconds > "$out/start.time"
df -B1 . "$HOME" /tmp "$TMPDIR" /datapool/mantle-store/nix-build-dir-20261025 > "$out/storage-before.txt"
nix config show build-dir > "$out/build-dir.txt"
printf '%s\n' 'nix flake check --offline --no-write-lock-file -L' > "$out/flake.command"
nix flake check --offline --no-write-lock-file -L > "$out/flake.stdout.log" 2> "$out/flake.stderr.log"
status=$?
printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$out/flake.exit"
printf 'flake exit=%s\n' "$status"
snapshot end
date --iso-8601=seconds > "$out/end.time"
df -B1 . "$HOME" /tmp "$TMPDIR" /datapool/mantle-store/nix-build-dir-20261025 > "$out/storage-after.txt"
python3 - "$out" <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
def table(label):
    return dict(line.split('  ', 1)[::-1] for line in (out / f'{label}.blake3').read_text().splitlines())
start, end = table('start'), table('end')
result = {
    'schema': 'mantle-final-gates-tree-binding-v1',
    'head_start': (out / 'start.head').read_text().strip(),
    'head_end': (out / 'end.head').read_text().strip(),
    'files_start': len(start), 'files_end': len(end),
    'changed': sorted(path for path in start.keys() & end.keys() if start[path] != end[path]),
    'added': sorted(end.keys() - start.keys()),
    'removed': sorted(start.keys() - end.keys()),
    'gates_exit': int((out / 'flake.exit').read_text()),
    'snapshot_read_errors': {label: (out / f'{label}.unreadable').read_text() for label in ['start', 'end']},
}
result['tree_unchanged'] = not any(result[key] for key in ['changed', 'added', 'removed']) and result['head_start'] == result['head_end'] and not any(result['snapshot_read_errors'].values())
(out / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({key: result[key] for key in ['gates_exit', 'tree_unchanged', 'changed', 'added', 'removed']}))
PY
exit "$status"
